description: Search the x402 Bazaar catalogs for paid APIs by keyword, with prices. Searches the public discovery catalogs of the Coinbase CDP facilitator and the PayAI facilitator, merges and de-duplicates the results and returns each resource URL with its description, method, network and USD price. Filter by network or maximum price. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
